einzeiler: Hot jobs report sparks rate hike bets and drops major indexes.
kurzfassung: A stronger-than-expected jobs report caused U.S. stocks and short-term bond prices to drop as traders anticipated a Federal Reserve rate hike. The economy added 162,000 jobs in August, significantly exceeding economist forecasts and driving diesel prices to a record high. Meanwhile, individual corporate moves included Volkswagen planning massive job cuts and Lululemon lowering its outlook.
stichpunkte: U.S. stocks and short-term bond prices declined following a hot jobs report.
Traders increased bets on a potential Federal Reserve rate hike later in the month.
The U.S. economy added 162,000 jobs in August, tripling economist expectations.
Diesel prices reached a new record high of $5.85 per gallon.
Volkswagen shares rose 6.5 percent after approving plans to double job cuts.
Lululemon shares dropped 17 percent after cutting its outlook for the second time this year.
Adobe shares fell over 6.5 percent following a CEO transition announcement.
Smith & Wesson shares grew 5 percent after reporting a jump in quarterly sales.
